Your task is to provide a step-by-step explanation of how the bug occurred using all available evidence:

– the current bug report,

Title: Diagnosis
Details: The corresponding issue report describes that tooltip text in the UI is displayed with HTML entities such as " instead of the intended characters. This strongly suggests a missing escaping or decoding step in tooltip generation. Inspecting the implementation of StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment reveals that it directly returns the toolTipText without applying any escaping. Recent issue reports mention similar encoding or escaping problems in related UI components, reinforcing the suspicion that this method lacks proper handling. The behavior observed in the code matches the issue report's symptoms, indicating that missing escaping in this method is the likely root cause.

After providing this diagnosis, you will be prompted to suggest which methods would be the best locations to be fixed. The answers should be in the form of `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` without commentary (one per line), as your answer will be automatically processed before finally being presented to the user.

messages.content:
The `ebeMultiply` method in the `OpenMapRealVector` class performs element-by-element multiplication of two vectors. The method loops through the non-zero entries of the vector and computes the product with the corresponding entry in the input vector.

The bug report mentions that the method returns wrong values when one entry of the specified `RealVector` is `NaN` or `Infinity`. Looking at the implementation of the `ebeMultiply` method, it handles the special case where `this[i] == 0d` and `(v[i] = NaN or v[i] = Infinity)` by setting the entry in the result vector to 0. However, it seems that this handling is not sufficient to address the issue.

Next, I will investigate the `doTestEbeBinaryOperation` method called by the `testEbeMultiplyMixedTypes` test to understand how the `ebeMultiply` method is being tested.

messages.content:
The `doTestEbeBinaryOperation` method in the `SparseRealVectorTest` class is used to test element-wise binary operations (`ADD`, `SUB`, `MUL`, `DIV`) between two vectors. The method covers different cases of combining values and checks the expected result against the actual result obtained from the operation.

In the `testEbeMultiplyMixedTypes` test method, the `doTestEbeBinaryOperation` is called with the operation `BinaryOperation.MUL` to test the element-wise multiplication of two vectors. The method creates two vectors with different values, performs the element-wise multiplication using the `ebeMultiply` method, and then compares the expected result with the actual result using `Assert.assertEquals`.

Based on the bug report indicating issues with `NaN` or `Infinity` values in the `ebeMultiply` method, it seems that the test might not be covering scenarios involving `NaN` or `Infinity` values adequately. Further investigation is needed to determine if there are specific test cases with `NaN` or `Infinity` values that are not handled correctly in the implementation of the `ebeMultiply` method.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
